After a tense VAR review, the referee pointed to the spot, and Ousmane Dembélé coolly converted the penalty, sending David Raya the wrong way. Real Madrid and Athletic Club faced off in a high-octane encounter that showcased tactical discipline and clinical attacking prowess. Fans were treated to a summer spectacle filled with technical brilliance and a relentless pursuit of goals from both sides. First-Half Flare-up and Volleyed Goals On July 26, 2026 , Real Madrid signaled their intent early, dominating possession and pinning Athletic Club back. The deadlock was broken in the 12th minute when Daniel Carvajal found Gonzalo Garcia , who composedly finished with his right foot. While the Basque side looked to find their footing, Madrid’s midfield engine kept the pressure high, eventually leading to a second goal in the 41st minute. Thiago Pitarch turned provider, lofting a ball for Jude Bellingham , who unleashed a sensational left-footed volley into the back of the net. However, Athletic Club refused to go into the break quietly. In the first minute of stoppage time, Inaki Williams delivered a pinpoint cross for Gorka Guruzeta , who mirrored Bellingham’s earlier effort with a stunning volley of his own. The goal halved the deficit and injected a surge of energy into the match just before the halftime whistle blew. Mbappé Magic and VAR Confirmation The second half began with a moment of pure class from Kylian Mbappé . In the 51st minute, the French forward received a pass from Alvaro Carreras and unleashed a powerful strike from outside the box that left the goalkeeper stranded. Real Madrid continued to dictate the tempo, maintaining 74% possession and creating numerous chances, though several offside calls against Mbappé and Pitarch kept the scoreline from swelling further. As the clock ticked toward full-time, the drama intensified. In the 88th minute, Brahim Diaz found the net, but the celebrations were momentarily halted for a VAR review. After a tense wait, the referee overturned the initial decision and awarded the goal to the home side. Athletic Club managed a late response in the 91st minute when Urko Izeta headed home from another Inaki Williams assist, but it was merely a consolation as Real Madrid secured a dominant victory.
